title: Really nice but not SUPER impressed
text: Really nice but not SUPER impressed. For how little water this mists out, I'm not impressed at all. You'd be better off with some sort of hand pump mister or even a water bottle like you spray your hair with. You can't feel much of a difference with how little water this puts into the air. It does make a little difference but you have to put the fan like right in your face. Not the miracle fan you were hoping for .
